title: Binance WebSocket Client & Fallback Generator
description: Implement the core WebSocket client handling connections to stream.binance.com for aggTrade, depth20@100ms, and kline streams. Include exponential backoff reconnection and a synthetic realistic fallback data generator when offline.
acceptanceCriteria: Client successfully connects and parses live Binance messages
Synthetic fallback generator emits valid trade, depth, and kline messages upon network timeout
Unit tests verify reconnection backoff and fallback data schema
